approve.heading: Host approval
approve.intro: Nothing is requested from a partner endpoint until an alliance administrator has confirmed, through a known contact, that its host belongs to the partner. Changing the host later clears the approval.
approve.askAlliance: Ask an alliance administrator to approve this host; harvesting and connection tests start after the approval.
approve.confirmMessage: Confirm that {host} belongs to this organization. OECP will then send requests with the stored credential to it.

channels.form: Web form: courses are edited in OECP
channels.csv: CSV upload: courses come from uploaded files
channels.oeapi: OEAPI harvest: courses are read from the university's OEAPI v5 endpoint

hints.channel: The one channel through which the organization's courses arrive. With OEAPI harvesting, CSV uploads are refused and the web form can only override harvested values.
hints.access: Used with OEAPI harvesting: either the university's own endpoint, or the SURFeduhub gateway.
hints.baseUrl: For example https://oeapi.uni.example/v5 (https, without query or credentials).
hints.endpointId: The endpoint id of the university in SURFeduhub.
hints.consumerProfile: Value of the OEAPI consumer parameter; eduxchange unless agreed otherwise.
hints.credentials: The credential is stored encrypted and never shown again; you can only keep, replace or delete it.
hints.secret: Paste the value issued by the university's IT.
hints.cron: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, e.g. 30 2 * * 1-5.
hints.rate: At most this many requests per second to the endpoint (more than 0, up to 999.9).
hints.absences: A course missing from this many consecutive harvests is withdrawn (1 to 30).
hints.enabled: Runs the schedule. Possible only with OEAPI harvesting; test the connection and run Sync now first.

secret.deletedWithNone: Saving with authentication None deletes the stored credential.

integration.actionsHint: Test connection and Sync now use the saved settings, not unsaved changes.

test.blocked: The connection cannot be tested yet

hints.unauthorized: The endpoint refused the credential: check the authentication method and the credential.
hints.unreachable: The endpoint could not be reached: check that the university's firewall allows OECP, and the DNS name.
hints.timeout: The endpoint did not answer in time: check the firewall and the endpoint's load.
hints.address_refused: The host name resolves to a private address, which OECP never calls.
hints.invalid_payload: The answer of /courses is not an OEAPI v5 page: check the path prefix and the version in the base URL.
